def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    if isinstance(entity_ids, (pd.Series, list, np.ndarray)):
        prod_list = list(entity_ids)
    else:
        prod_list = [entity_ids]

    empty_index = pd.Index(prod_list, name="product_id")

    # --- Товарные позиции: только те, что известны на момент seed_time ---
    items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time]
    items = items[items["product_id"].isin(prod_list)]

    # --- Отзывы: доступны не раньше момента публикации ответа ---
    rev_known = reviews[reviews["review_answer_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    reviews_agg = rev_known.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        num_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        num_low_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).sum()),
    ).reset_index()

    # --- Платежи: известны только если платёж уже произведён ---
    pay_known = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    payments_agg = pay_known.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        num_payments=("payment_value", "count"),
        sum_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    if items.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame({"has_sales": 0}, index=empty_index)

    merged = items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                "order_status", "order_delivered_customer_date"]],
        on="order_id", how="left",
    )
    # заказ должен быть оформлен до seed_time
    merged = merged[merged["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    if merged.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame({"has_sales": 0}, index=empty_index)

    order_data = merged.groupby(["product_id", "order_id"]).agg(
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        num_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        purchase_date=("order_purchase_timestamp", "first"),
        delivered_date=("order_delivered_customer_date", "first"),
    ).reset_index()

    order_data = order_data.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    order_data = order_data.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    fill_cols = ["avg_review_score", "num_reviews", "num_low_reviews",
                 "avg_payment_value", "num_payments", "sum_payment_value",
                 "max_installments"]
    for col in fill_cols:
        order_data[col] = order_data[col].fillna(0)

    # доставка уже состоялась на момент seed_time?
    order_data["is_delivered"] = (
        order_data["delivered_date"].notna()
        & (order_data["delivered_date"] < seed_time)
    ).astype(int)
    delivered = order_data["is_delivered"] == 1
    order_data.loc[delivered, "delivery_days"] = (
        order_data.loc[delivered, "delivered_date"]
        - order_data.loc[delivered, "purchase_date"]
    ).dt.days

    # индикаторы окон
    for days in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        border = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        order_data[f"wd_{days}"] = (order_data["purchase_date"] >= border).astype(int)

    agg_dict = {
        "order_id": "nunique",
        "total_price": ["sum", "mean", "std", "max"],
        "total_freight": ["sum", "mean"],
        "num_items": ["sum", "mean", "max"],
        "avg_review_score": ["mean", "std", "min"],
        "num_reviews": ["sum", "mean"],
        "num_low_reviews": "sum",
        "avg_payment_value": ["mean", "std"],
        "num_payments": ["sum"],
        "sum_payment_value": "sum",
        "max_installments": "max",
        "is_delivered": ["mean", "sum"],
        "delivery_days": ["mean", "std"],
        "purchase_date": ["min", "max", "count"],
    }
    for d in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        agg_dict[f"wd_{d}"] = "sum"

    grouped = order_data.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_dict)
    grouped.columns = ["_".join(str(c) for c in col).strip("_")
                       for col in grouped.columns.values]

    # для delivery_days mean по отсутствию доставки — NaN, заменяем позже
    grouped["recency_days"] = (seed_time - grouped["purchase_date_max"]).dt.days
    grouped["product_age_days"] = (
        grouped["purchase_date_max"] - grouped["purchase_date_min"]
    ).dt.days
    grouped["sales_rate_90d"] = grouped["wd_90_sum"] / 90.0
    grouped["sales_rate_180d"] = grouped["wd_180_sum"] / 180.0
    # доля последних 90 дней в объёме за год
    grouped["trend_90_365"] = grouped["wd_90_sum"] / (grouped["wd_365_sum"] + 1)
    # средний интервал между заказами
    grouped["avg_order_gap_days"] = np.where(
        grouped["purchase_date_count"] > 1,
        grouped["product_age_days"] / (grouped["purchase_date_count"] - 1),
        999,
    )

    grouped.drop(columns=[c for c in grouped.columns if c.startswith("purchase_date_")],
                 inplace=True)

    features = grouped.reindex(prod_list)
    features["has_sales"] = (features["order_id_nunique"].fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    return features
